content: Zoomable canvas WMs: none mature on macOS found in public search (excluding the reference app). Linux prior art: Niri overview (25.05) zooms out workspaces, drag windows between workspaces, hot corner, 4-finger swipe; driftwm infinite canvas camera with trackpad pan/zoom and zoom-to-fit; Phantomat (Hyprland) zoom-out-everything with type-to-jump and minimap; academic ZUI X11 WM. OmniWM on macOS has an Overview with remembered zoom.
